title: Harold Malmgren tweets about Bissell briefings and Tesla/Brown submarine work

tellings.quote: a guy named Harold Malmgrren and he is a presidential adviser for JFK LBJ Nixon and and Ford and he has come out he's been tweeting a bunch about uh things that he learned in that capacity and and getting briefed by Richard Bissell

plain: Harold Malmgren, an adviser to Presidents Kennedy, Johnson, Nixon and Ford, has been tweeting about things he learned in that role, including briefings from the CIA official Richard Bissell. Michels brings this up himself, describing the tweets rather than quoting them, with the UFO disclosure activist Steven Greer, and it would mean a man close to four presidents is publicly confirming he was told of secret UFO matters.
